invariants.statement: Every gateway boot mints a new epoch and starts DISARMED.
A prior boot epoch never acquires or commands authority.
At most one writer owns the fake Sport service; conflict stops and latches.
Authority-bearing client sequences increase strictly across the entire gateway boot, including reacquisition after disconnect.
Only a bounded duration TTL crosses the wire; the gateway derives expiry on its local clock.
Client loss after a nonzero admission initiates local StopMove and cannot auto-resume.
Lease loss or stale/out-of-order fake feedback removes positive authority and stops.
A delayed Move completing across a stop epoch is followed by a compensating StopMove.
Protocol version, packet/string/integer/TTL bounds, frame, finite numeric values, and compatibility hashes fail closed; velocity-envelope admission remains outside N24.
An admission ACK never claims vendor motion or stationary truth.
Stop confirmation requires successful StopMove plus a fresh later stationary fake-state sample.
A blocked, raising, full, or incomplete fake evidence sink cannot delay or change stop control; incomplete process evidence exits nonzero.
